raw_history_retention: Server only; publish binned CSV and figures, never history-records.json

definitions.loss_mean: Unweighted mean of logged microbatch losses within fixed microstep bins; not token-weighted validation loss or every training batch
definitions.learning_rate_last: Last logged optimizer LR in the bin
definitions.grad_norm_median: Median last-update gradient norms observed at logged microsteps
definitions.padded_tokens_per_second_median: Median of logged segment-average padded throughput; includes padding and unsupervised context, not instantaneous supervised-token throughput
definitions.cuda_memory: Last PyTorch allocated/reserved/process-peak values in each bin, GiB; not nvidia-smi device total
definitions.bin_policy: Fixed from full configured budget, including partial final bin; gaps remain gaps, never zero-filled

limits: Single run and partial-stage evidence unless final-stage. Loss decline alone does not prove model capability. This exporter does not certify the whole experiment.
